title: Play
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 9 Creative Arts and Sports; not yet checked by a CBC Creative Arts and Sports teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Read a short Kenyan play script; learners write and act a one-act play on a societal issue.

skills.key_step: The child names the parts of a script: title, cast list, acts and scenes, the character's name before each speech, dialogue without quotation marks, stage directions in brackets.

floor.prerequisite: Describes the elements of a play.
floor.question: What is dialogue?

contexts: a one-act play on drug abuse

board.do: How would a script write it?

listen_for: in quotation marks, like a story
misconceptions.ask: How is dialogue written in a play script?
misconceptions.repair: Show a story page and a script page side by side.

misconceptions.ask: How are stage directions shown in a script?
misconceptions.repair: Underline every stage direction in a sample script.

misconceptions.ask: What comes at the start of a play script, after the title?
misconceptions.repair: Read the first page of a published play.

misconceptions.ask: Which is bigger: an act or a scene?
misconceptions.repair: Show a contents page: Act 1, Scenes 1-3.

checks.question: What comes first in a script after the title?
